instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL: npm install framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge lucide-react @radix-ui/react-slot
FONTS: Add 'Unbounded' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.html or CSS import.
THEME: Force DARK MODE by default. The casino should not have a light mode.
ANIMATION: Use framer-motion for all page transitions and game interactions (card flips, wheel spins).
PAYMENTS: Use 'CreditCard' icon for Stripe and 'Banknote' icon for PayID. Stripe color: #635BFF. PayID color: #002B45 (or white on dark).
AUTH: Create a custom JWT hook. Do not rely on external auth providers for the UI logic.
GAMES: Implement actual game logic (RNG) in frontend for demo purposes, but structure it to call backend API for real bets.
CRITICAL: Ensure 'Deposit' button is always visible and distinct (e.g., fixed bottom bar on mobile, top right on desktop).

do_not: Do not use generic 'Inter' font for headings.
Do not use standard Bootstrap/MUI blue colors.
Do not make the UI cluttered. Use negative space.
Do not use 'alert' for errors. Use 'sonner' toasts.
must_do: Ensure mobile responsiveness is perfect (touch targets > 44px).
Use gradients for primary actions to make them pop against the dark background.
